items.title: Payment demanded for private 'land registry' entry
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date for payment ('Zahlbar bis 01.12.2026'), so the due date is used exactly as printed; no period calculation is needed.

warnings: This matches a well-known German scam pattern: a private company sends an invoice-like letter mimicking the official land registry ('Grundstücksregister'/Grundbuch), but the fine print says the entry is only in the sender's private directory and has nothing to do with the official Grundbuch ('Die Eintragung erfolgt im privaten Verzeichnis des Absenders und steht in keinem Zusammenhang mit dem amtlichen Grundbuch').

The small print also states this document is merely an offer and that a contract only comes into being if payment is made ('Dieses Schreiben ist ein Angebot. Mit Ihrer Zahlung nehmen Sie es an; ein Vertrag kommt erst durch die Zahlung zustande.') — meaning there is no existing obligation to pay at all; the recipient should not pay this and should verify independently (e.g. with their actual Grundbuchamt) before taking any action.
No genuine authority or court requested this payment; it is strongly recommended to disregard or report this letter rather than pay the stated 498,00 EUR.
